description: This file defines the Meminfo struct and functions to parse and retrieve system memory statistics from /proc/meminfo in Linux, as part of the Prometheus procfs package.

classes.name: Meminfo
classes.description: Struct representing detailed Linux system memory statistics, including total, free, cached, swap, and various other memory metrics.

methods.name: FS.Meminfo
methods.description: Reads and returns current system memory information by parsing /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: parseMemInfo
methods.description: Parses the content of /proc/meminfo and populates a Meminfo struct with the extracted data.
